findings.title: Lethal trifecta: untrusted input + private data + external sink
findings.detail: Server "company-data" exposes tools that together enable an exfiltration flow. Untrusted content: company_profile, company_jobs, companies_hiring_scan, email_auth_check, domain_lookup, website_tech_stack · Private data: company_enrich, email_find, email_auth_check, domain_lookup · Public sink: company_profile, company_hiring_trend, companies_hiring_scan, jobs_salary, email_find, email_validate, email_auth_check, domain_lookup, sec_13f_holdings.

evidence.snippet: Untrusted content: company_profile, company_jobs, companies_hiring_scan, email_auth_check, domain_lookup, website_tech_stack · Private data: company_enrich, email_find, email_auth_check, domain_lookup · Public sink: company_profile, company_hiring_trend, companies_hiring_scan, jobs_salary, email_find, email_validate, email_auth_check, domain_lookup, sec_13f_holdings

findings.remediation: Do not co-install these capabilities under one trust boundary; an injected comment/email can steer the model to exfiltrate via the sink tool.
